notes: Gifts the Claim window hands out (gifts-codes piece, owner 2026-11-11). Rebuilt by the lab's gifts-codes builder from the wiki pages it cites in each row's evidence; every item id was resolved by name (or by its client locale row) through the item definitions in data/release (item-table.json, item-table-supplement.json and the captured inventory.json rows) and the client locale, and name_id pins that binding.

source: profile = the website profile page's ad offers; promotional = a promotion, tie-in or login gift with no known code; member = a monthly member pack (the membership gate is gone). All three are standing offers: while enabled (and their event runs) every account finds them in its Claim window. code = a published code (realm redeem <code> puts the gift in the Claim window). Staff can send any row or make a code for it.

Defaults (R): per account; the original codes work again; event rows only while their event runs (live_event, the event_calendar.json key); the rows the wiki says kept reappearing repeat every 24 hours; everything else once. tradeable is the wiki's word for profile rows and the client item's own no-trade flag for the rest.
Dropped source facts: the profile offers were for US accounts only (no country gate here); watching the ad (no ad here); the member packs were for paying members (free here).

Limited rows: stock_per_event (claims the realm may make per event run, all time without an event), per_player (claims one player may make per run) and stock_group (rows of one group share both counters), B2's shop fields; null is unlimited.
unresolved lists the items that cannot be given yet and why: missing work (an item row to build, a source to find), never not-applicable.
